title: SYSTOS 4D Semantic HRR Database
description: Four-dimensional semantic database architecture using direct numerical identity, indirect numerical semantic coordinates, HRR vector representations, and temporal/contextual state.

dimensions.D1_direct: Stable numerical identity and explicit ontology position.
dimensions.D2_indirect: Distributed semantic coordinates derived from related concepts and weighted relationships.
dimensions.D3_hrr: High-dimensional holographic reduced representation used for associative retrieval and similarity.
dimensions.D4_temporal_context: Time, place, state, provenance, and situational context.

principles: Numerical taxonomy is a projection, not the underlying ontology.
A record may occupy multiple semantic regions without duplication.
Direct numbers identify; indirect numbers associate; HRR vectors retrieve; temporal/contextual coordinates situate.
Relationships are first-class data with weights, provenance, confidence, and temporal scope.
Formal rules and observed practice remain distinct.
Claims, counterclaims, evidence, and uncertainty remain distinct.
Corruption, failure, abuse, resistance, and reform are first-class system phenomena.
Historical systems may have multiple simultaneous geographic or institutional variants.
Semantic proximity must never be treated as proof of historical causation.
